title: Revenue overview 2024
description: Monthly revenue by region with targets, share of revenue and customer economics.

summary.sql: with years as (select date_trunc('year', order_date) as year, sum(revenue) as revenue, count(*) as orders from fct_orders where order_date >= date '2023-01-01' and order_date < date '2025-01-01' group by 1) select cur.revenue as total_revenue, prev.revenue as prior_revenue, cur.orders, cur.revenue / cur.orders as avg_order_value, (cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / prev.revenue as growth from years cur join years prev on prev.year = cur.year - interval '1 year' where cur.year = date '2024-01-01'

revenue_monthly.sql: select date_trunc('month', o.order_date) as month, r.region, sum(o.revenue) as revenue, count(*) as orders, max(t.target) as target from fct_orders o join dim_region r on r.region_id = o.region_id left join monthly_targets t on t.region = r.region and t.month = date_trunc('month', o.order_date) where o.order_date >= date '2024-01-01' and o.order_date < date '2025-01-01' group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

revenue_by_region.sql: with cur as (select r.region, sum(o.revenue) as revenue, count(distinct o.customer_id) as customers, sum(o.revenue) / count(*) as avg_order_value from fct_orders o join dim_region r on r.region_id = o.region_id where o.order_date >= date '2024-01-01' and o.order_date < date '2025-01-01' group by 1), prev as (select r.region, sum(o.revenue) as revenue from fct_orders o join dim_region r on r.region_id = o.region_id where o.order_date >= date '2023-01-01' and o.order_date < date '2024-01-01' group by 1), targets as (select region, sum(target) as target from monthly_targets where month >= date '2024-01-01' and month < date '2025-01-01' group by 1) select cur.region, cur.revenue, targets.target, cur.customers, cur.avg_order_value, (cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / prev.revenue as growth from cur join prev on prev.region = cur.region join targets on targets.region = cur.region
